Dispatch economy: the worker packet is built with `topo_order.py --emit ... --out-dir .claude/skills-state/sdlc-code/packets` and packet FILES appear there — the packet JSON is never pasted into the worker brief and never dumped into the manager's own output. The brief REFERENCES the emit-rules.md worker digest by absolute path rather than quoting it, references a tech-stack slice under .claude/skills-state/sdlc-code/stack/demo-api.md, names the breadcrumb path, and quotes the capped report format (UNIT/FILES/STATIC/UNIT_RING/HEALS/STATUS). The breadcrumb is deleted when the unit is ledgered.

Component checkpoint: when the last task with component_ref 'items-controller' completes, the run drains, runs the component ring, prints the compact component summary (tasks, ring exit code, heals, escalations, findings, budget, elapsed, absolute progress), and runs `doctor.py --quick`. With everything green and no findings, it does NOT stop — it logs one line and continues (adaptive policy). It stops only on an attention trigger; the default next_component budget being reached is one such trigger and produces a resume card naming `/sdlc:code demo-api` in a NEW session.

Spec defect during codegen: with ARCH__demo-api.yaml hand-edited so createItem's work_unit no longer determines its return shape, the run does NOT patch the task embed and does NOT invent behaviour. It appends an FND-NNN entry to .claude/skills-state/sdlc-findings.yaml (kind contract_underdetermined, evidence carrying the captured exit code and the contract excerpt, suspected_stage arch), marks the task failed after the heal ladder, and surfaces the finding at the component gate with a 'stop and run /sdlc:repair' option. docs/ is never edited.
